sentences.en: Worship Allah and don't associate anything with him.

parts.label: a
parts.ask: If it's not حال, choose ليست حالا and move on. If it's حال, choose حال and then choose the ruling applicable for a واو حالية in terms of its importance by ticking one of the boxes from: منع الواو | جواز الواو | وجوب الواو.

parts.label: b
parts.ask: Explain why you chose what you chose.
parts.answer: The jumla وَلَا تُشْرِكُوا is a prohibitive (نهي) jumla insha'iyyah, so it can't be a حال because a Jumla Inshaiyya cannot be a حال.
parts.feedback: The jumla is actually a prohibitive, a نهي, therefore it can't be a haal because a Jumla Inshaiyya does not be a haal.
